title: Practice by Nazareth Hassan at Playwrights Horizons #practiceplay #na...
transcript: Run, don't walk, to see Practice at Playwrights Horizons. I was at last night's first preview and I absolutely loved it. This new play by Nazareth Hassan is about a group of actors devising a theater piece based on themselves. In some ways, it's pretty conventional, but it kinda goes sideways in the best way possible. There's a lot more to this, but I think it's best left spoiler-free. I will say it's incredibly impressive as a feat of writing, ensemble work, and technical execution. The performances across the board are fantastic, and there are plenty of moments where you can cut the dramatic tension with a knife. Although this piece doesn't necessarily move quickly, it's very well-paced and captivating the entire time, consistently serving jokes and shocks. I may never look at jelly beans the same way again, but it was worth it. Last night, the show clocked in at just over three hours, but the runtime honestly felt earned. When you get such a prolonged and intimate look at these characters, and when the progression of reveals is so well-orchestrated, the payoff is extraordinary. That's all you really need to know, just go see it. With that, another program for my collection.
